name: UI Field Guide
pitch: A searchable library of named UI elements with live previews, and a drag-and-drop mockup builder.
problem: It's hard to ask for a UI element when you don't know its name.

stats.label: elements, each with a live preview
groups, from buttons to AI and chat
preview styles, from glass to brutalist

features.title: Every element, named
features.text: Live previews, the other names people use, and a short code for each.
details: What it is, when to use it, what it gets mixed up with
Restyle every preview at once, with any accent colour
Help me choose suggests elements from a few questions

features.title: Know what to ask for
features.text: Each element's page says exactly what to call it in a request.
details: Also called: thermostat dial, climate dial
Often confused with: rotary knob, gauge
